say:1:1033414001:1.text: Even if Captain Parisa doesn't blame me, I blame myself for everything.
say:1:1033414001:1.source_cn: 就算帕瑞莎队长不怪我，我内心的愧疚也不会消减。
say:1:1033414001:1.male: Even if Captain Parisa doesn't blame me, I blame myself for everything.
say:1:1033414001:1.female: Even if Captain Parisa doesn't blame me, I blame myself for everything.

say:2:1033414002:1.text: I was right there, watching them accuse her.
say:2:1033414002:1.source_cn: 当时的我站在队伍里，就那么看着大家一起指责她。
say:2:1033414002:1.male: I was right there, watching them accuse her.
say:2:1033414002:1.female: I was right there, watching them accuse her.

say:3:1033414003:1.text: I hate how cowardly I was! Why didn't I stand by her bravely like Kafra?
say:3:1033414003:1.source_cn: 我恨那时的懦弱。为什么我不能像卡夫拉一样，勇敢地站在她身旁？
say:3:1033414003:1.male: I hate how cowardly I was! Why didn't I stand by her bravely like Kafra?
say:3:1033414003:1.female: I hate how cowardly I was! Why didn't I stand by her bravely like Kafra?
